:::{#def-cov-vec-x}

#### Variance-covariance matrix (covariance matrix, variance matrix)

[]{#thm-vcov-elements}

For a $p \times 1$ [random vector](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $\vX = \tp{(X_1, \ldots, X_p)}$
with $\E{X_i^2} < \infty$ for every $i$,
the **variance-covariance matrix** of $\vX$,
also called its **covariance matrix** or **variance matrix**,
is the $p \times p$ [matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix) whose $(i,j)$-th element is the [covariance](#def-cov) $\Covs{X_i}{X_j}$:

$$
\ba
\Varf{\vX}
&\eqdef \Covf{\vX}
\\
&\eqdef
\pmat{
\Covs{X_1}{X_1} & \Covs{X_1}{X_2} & \cdots & \Covs{X_1}{X_p} \\
\Covs{X_2}{X_1} & \Covs{X_2}{X_2} & \cdots & \Covs{X_2}{X_p} \\
\vdots          & \vdots          & \ddots & \vdots           \\
\Covs{X_p}{X_1} & \Covs{X_p}{X_2} & \cdots & \Covs{X_p}{X_p}
}
\ea
$$

:::
